title: $\operatorname{Pic}$ is the divisor class group for smooth curves
statement:
Let $C$ be a smooth connected curve over $k$
(proper or not; for a disconnected smooth curve the assertion holds
componentwise). The map

$$
\operatorname{Cl}(C)\to\operatorname{Pic}(C),\qquad
D\mapsto[\mathcal O_C(D)],
$$

is an isomorphism of abelian groups (the group law on $\operatorname{Pic}(C)$ being [lem-sc-pic-group]).

proof.text: Supply C.Over by f. Obtain the integral instance from smooth_connected_curve_local_rings and Noetherianity from locally finite type over k. Since C is irreducible, smoothOfRelativeDimension_iff_topologicalKrullDim_eq and the dimension-one field of IsConnectedCurve give SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f.

Apply the existing source-library point-ideal divisor-class equivalence [lem-sc-divisor-class-toPic-equivalence] to obtain e with e([D]) = Divisor.toPic k C D. This implementation supplies the well-defined homomorphism, its kernel calculation, and surjectivity, following the divisor-class argument of this unit.

For each D rewrite by the computation rule of e, then apply [lem-sc-divisor-toPic-representative] to obtain the required representative isomorphism. No quotient or bijectivity statement is assumed by this comparison lemma.
